lessons.pattern: Validate request body shape before passing values to persistence helpers.
lessons.context: A handler accepted optional fields and allowed undefined values to reach a storage adapter.
lessons.fix: Add a schema guard at the route boundary and return a typed validation error before storage calls.

lessons.pattern: Do not derive React state from props in an effect when it can be computed during render.
lessons.context: A component copied props into local state and produced stale UI during rapid navigation.
lessons.fix: Compute the view model from current props with memoization only when profiling shows it is needed.

lessons.pattern: Resolve CLI file paths from the repository root, not from the caller shell directory.
lessons.context: A command worked in local smoke tests but failed from nested working directories.
lessons.fix: Anchor default paths to import.meta.url and only resolve user-provided paths relative to the repo root.

lessons.pattern: Batch independent file reads before CPU-heavy parsing to reduce idle I/O time.
lessons.context: A report generator read and parsed files sequentially, causing slow runs on large metric snapshots.
lessons.fix: Collect candidate paths first, read files concurrently with a bounded pool, then parse in deterministic order.
